org.portico.bindings.jgroups

Class Federation

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.bindings.jgroups.Federation

  • public class Federation
extends Object
    Class represents a link to a particular federation. This contains the actual Channel that is used for communication and potentially an instance of the Gateway for a WAN connection if relevant. Instances of this class are created and stored in a connection even before we know there is actually a federate operating on the channel (we need to connect to find this out, and this class is created to hold the connection). When a federate joins a federation, it's LRC is handed to that Federation instance which in turn allows messages to be routed back to it. On resignation, this link is removed.

      • sendCreateFederation

        public void sendCreateFederation(ObjectModel fom)
                          throws JFederationExecutionAlreadyExists,
                                 Exception
        Checks to make sure that the group we are connected to does not already contain a federation. If it does not, the FOM is sent out to all participants so that they can record it and register a federation as active.
        Throws:
        Exception - If there is a problem sending the message out
        JFederationExecutionAlreadyExists - If there is a federation already in the channel

      • sendJoinFederation

        public String sendJoinFederation(String federateName,
                                 LRC lrc)
                          throws JFederationExecutionDoesNotExist,
                                 JFederateAlreadyExecutionMember,
                                 Exception
        Validates that the federation exists to join and then checks the name requested by the federate. If there is a joined federate with the same name AND unique names are *required* (RID option), an exception will be thrown, otherwise the name of the federate will be modified to put a number on the end in the format: "federateName-federateHandle". The string returned by this method is the name that the federate has been given, which in most cases will be the one that they requested.
        Parameters:
        federateName - The name the federate wishes to use
        lrc - The LRC this federate should ultimately route incoming messages to
        Returns:
        The name that the federate has been given
        Throws:
        JFederationExecutionDoesNotExist - If there is no active federation
        JFederateAlreadyExecutionMember - If the name is taken and unique name are required
        Exception - If there is a comms problem sending the message

      • sendResignFederation

        public void sendResignFederation(PorticoMessage resignMessage)
                          throws Exception
        Sends the resignation notification out with the appropriate header so that it is detected by other channel members, allowing them to update their manifest appropriately. After this method returns, the local connection will unlink itself from the LRC it had previously tied into as part of #joinFederation(String, LRC).
        Parameters:
        resignMessage - The Portico message for the resignation, contains resign action
        Throws:
        Exception - If there is a communications problem

      • sendDestroyFederation

        public void sendDestroyFederation()
                           throws JFederationExecutionDoesNotExist,
                                  JFederatesCurrentlyJoined,
                                  Exception
        Notifies all other connections on the channel that the federation should be destroyed. Checks are done first to make sure the channel is in a state to service this request, including a check to make sure there actually is an active federation to destroy, and that there are no federates joined to it.
        Throws:
        Exception
        JFederationExecutionDoesNotExist
        JFederatesCurrentlyJoined
